name: Reaper Extinction procs off direct Physical damage and grants the buff (#2171)
contract: Extinction 573039 reads 'Direct Physical damage dealt now has a 5% chance to grant you Extinction for
$560414d. Chance to trigger this effect is increased by 10% for each Reaped Soul active.'
Its only DBC effect is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) triggering the Stack Adder 520501, but
the record's ProcTypeMask is 0, so without spell_proc/spell_script_names rows the proc has no event to
rev_20260920_11_reaper_extinction_proc.sql (already on origin/main via merged PR #4280, commit
85b231bc0) supplies ProcFlags 20 (melee auto attack | melee-class spell damage), SchoolMask 1
(Physical), SpellPhaseMask 2 (hit) and binds spell_ascension_reaper_extinction, which rolls BaseChance 5
Original Reaped Soul 500363 has a maximum of three stacks and uses original SpellDuration entry 2,
300000010 ms. Assert three souls and sufficient native duration before attacking, and three souls
afterward. Effective spell_proc sets its preliminary chance to 100 percent, leaving the original script
roll at 5 + 10*3 = 35 percent. Preserve that probability while collecting at least 40 actual Physical
melee damage events, with native hit and expertise fixtures that exclude missed or avoided submissions.
Observe the actual granted Extinction aura without injecting it, count native Stack Adder casts, and
check the fixed cohort against 35 percent with an exact binomial test. Zero successes have probability
0.65^40, about 3.3e-8, instead of the previous assumed 22 swings.
